propositions: Test workers race on a shared git index when two concurrent writers call add and commit as separate run_git_write invocations, causing one writer's commit to sweep up the other's staged changes
A losing writer observes rc=1 with empty stderr from git commit because the index is empty after the winning writer's commit, producing a bare AssertionError with no diagnostic output
Test assertions report only stderr and lack command identification, making empty-stderr failures undiagnosable from CI logs
Fix requires each worker to commit only its own pathspec rather than the whole index, ensuring both writers' commits succeed regardless of add/commit interleaving
No production code defect exists; the contention seam policy is correct and every git invocation behaves as intended
